title: Jardin botanique de Limbé
content: Created in 1892; official MINTOUL profile describes about 1,000 plant species, 500 trees and 48 hectares; includes Jungle Village and visitor trails.

title: Mont Cameroun
content: Volcanic mountain near the Atlantic coast; MINTOUL profile describes an elevation of about 4,100 m and the annual Course de l'Espoir.

title: Palais de Justice de Douala
content: Historic building in the first arrondissement of Douala, with German and French colonial-era history and architectural interest.

title: Chutes de la Lobé
content: UNESCO Tentative List cultural landscape; MINTOUL beach-tourism page identifies the Lobé waterfall as flowing directly into the sea at Kribi.

title: Taxi minimum city fare
content: MINTOUL states the minimum city taxi price is 250 FCFA; actual fare varies with distance. Value: 250 XAF

title: Typical individual city taxi course
content: MINTOUL says an individual city trip is generally around 2,000 FCFA, with price to be negotiated. Value: about 2,000 XAF

title: Airport taxi daytime
content: MINTOUL states an airport trip costs 3,500 FCFA in daytime. Value: 3,500 XAF

title: Airport taxi night
content: MINTOUL states an airport trip costs 5,000 FCFA at night after 18:00. Value: 5,000 XAF

title: Road toll
content: MINTOUL states a road toll of 500 FCFA per vehicle and station. Value: 500 XAF per vehicle per toll station

title: International airports
content: MINTOUL states Cameroon has three international airports: Yaoundé, Douala and Garoua. Value: Yaoundé, Douala, Garoua

title: Rail corridor
content: MINTOUL describes the Transcamerounais railway as connecting Douala to Ngaoundéré through Yaoundé. Value: Douala–Yaoundé–Ngaoundéré
